title.narrative: INTERNATIONAL W/S ON MEETING MENTAL HEALTH NEEDS OF PEOPLE IN DEVELOPING COUNTRIES

description.narrative: PROJECT OBJECTIVES: · To raise awareness of the need for mental health care services in developing countries among Christian leaders and Christian medical professionals, so that they can more effectively serve all the people in their own community. · To define and disseminate a Christian perspective on mental health care in developing countries, on the basis of biblical examples and patterns of care and compassion. · To involve and motivate key personnel, including church leaders, medical workers and government medical staff from a range of developing counties in Africa, Asia, South America and Eastern Europe, and to help them to formulate the best possible programme for meeting the mental health needs of the nation or community within which they work. · To define and disseminate simple and workable models of mental health care, by looking at existing models and suggesting ones that are adaptable to varying circumstances by Christian health providers. Also to determine appropriate methods for evaluating the mental health care programmes developed. · To encourage other organisations involved in health care in developing countries to add mental health care to their programmes. · To ensure post-workshop support for delegates, including formation of an international network of addresses and e-mail links to conference speakers, workshop leaders, other delegates, and other sources of information, advice and help on mental health care and related medical and nursing issues.
